City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
June 27, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
RECOGNITION OF FORMER COMMISSIONERS AND MEMBER OF THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to Jim Emmerling, Jack Miranda and Dr. Stephen Smith for their years of dedicated service to the community.
Item 6.1 Presentations

APPOINTMENT TO YOUTH COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council appoint Yvonne Chen as a member to the La Mirada Youth Council for a term expiring in October 2017.
Item 7.1 Appointment

CONSENT CALENDAR
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of June 13, 2017.
Item 8.1 Minutes

APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated June 27, 2017 in the total amount of $1,842,805.75.

ANNUAL REPORT OF THE LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS FOUNDATION - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Annual Report of the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Foundation.

LA MIRADA THEATRE FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS FOUNDATION AGREEMENT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-18 - It is recommended the City Council approve the Fiscal Year 2017-18 agreement between the City of La Mirada and the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts Foundation and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.

AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES FOR THE STRATEGIES AGAINST GANG ENVIRONMENTS (SAGE) PROGRAM - It is recommended the City Council approve a one-year agreement with the County of Los Angeles for the Strategies Against Gang Environments (SAGE) Program and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.

CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2016-11, ROOF REHABILITATION AT THE NEFF HOUSE, GEORGE HOUSE AND CARRIAGE BARN - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council approve plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2016-11, Roof Rehabilitation at the Neff House, George House and Carriage Barn and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
Item 8.9 CIP No. 2016-11
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 17-18 ADOPTING THE PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2017-18 BUDGET - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law and adopt Resolution No. 17-18 approving the Proposed Fiscal Year 2017-18 Budget.
Item 9.1 Public Hearing - Resolution No. 17-18
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 17-19 REGARDING EMPLOYER PAID MEMBER CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-19 regarding employer paid member contributions to the California Public Employees' Retirement System.
Item 10.1 Resolution No. 17-19
10.2
RESOLUTION NO. 17-20 ESTABLISHING THE APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-18 - It is recommended the City Council select the California Per Capita Personal Income percentage change from the preceding year as the inflation factor for Fiscal Year 2017-18; select the growth of the County as the population factor for Fiscal Year 2017-18; and adopt Resolution No. 17-20 establishing an Appropriations Limit for Fiscal Year 2017-18 pursuant to Article XIIIB of the California Constitution.
Item 10.2 Resolution No. 17-20
10.3
RESOLUTION NO. 17-21 REGARDING EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SALARY RATES FOR ALL CLASSES OF EMPLOYMENT, AND SUPERSEDING RESOLUTION NO. 16-17 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-21 regarding employment benefits and salary rates for all classes of employment, and superseding Resolution No. 16-17.
Item 10.3 Resolution No. 17-21
